description: This file defines templates and classes for representing and checking 'Regularity Profiles' in C++, used for compile-time type property assertions and conformance testing within the Abseil library. It includes mechanisms for describing type traits, support for various operations, and combining profiles for conformance validation.

classes.name: absl::types_internal::ConformanceErrors
classes.description: Class for managing and reporting conformance test errors and successes, integrating with gtest assertions.

methods.name: UnderlyingValue
methods.description: Converts an enum to its underlying integral value.

methods.name: addTestSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful test for a specific test name.

methods.name: addTestFailure
methods.description: Records a failed test with optional message arguments.

methods.name: assertionResult
methods.description: Returns a gtest AssertionResult indicating overall success or failure.

methods.name: expectFailedTests
methods.description: Generates a gtest AssertionResult for expected failures, reporting mismatches.

methods.name: outputDivider
methods.description: Outputs a visual divider in the error report.

methods.name: PropertiesOf
methods.description: Trait to extract the 'properties' type from a class.

methods.name: PropertiesOfT
methods.description: Alias for the properties type of a class.

methods.name: ExpectedFunctionKindList
methods.description: Generates a string listing expected function support levels.

methods.name: ExpectModelOfImpl
methods.description: Checks if a type's operation support level is within expected bounds.

methods.name: PropertyName
methods.description: Returns a string name for a given property enum.

methods.name: IsOpable
methods.description: Trait to check if an operation exists for a type.

methods.name: IsNothrowOpable
methods.description: Trait to check if an operation exists and is noexcept.

methods.name: ConformanceProfile
methods.description: Template representing a set of type property support levels.

methods.name: CombineProfiles
methods.description: Template to combine multiple conformance profiles into one.

methods.name: IsProfile
methods.description: Trait to check if a type is a conformance profile.
